description: The healing tide - restoration, shields and the totems that sustain a party.

nodes.name: Improved Healing Wave
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your Healing Wave by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Reduces the casting time of your Healing Wave spell by 0.1-0.5 sec.' DEPARTURE - there are no cast times. A shorter cast is more throughput, so it is delivered as healing. USES _healing, not _damage - the key that left 18 talents silently dead across four classes.

nodes.name: Totemic Focus
nodes.description: Reduces the mana cost of your totems by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0, built verbatim across all thirteen totems: 'Reduces the mana cost of your totems by 5%-25%.' _cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION. Kept from the outgoing tree, which covered three totems with the FLAT _cost key.

nodes.name: Improved Water Shield
nodes.description: Your critical heals restore 120 mana.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, NEW to our tree: 'You have a 33%-100% chance to instantly gain mana as if you consumed a Water Shield Orb when you gain a critical effect from your healing spells.' Built on the real trigger with the real chance curve. Orb consumption is not expressible - there is no charge system - so grant_resource delivers a flat 120, since it takes no pct_max.

nodes.name: Healing Grace
nodes.description: Reduces the threat your healing generates by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, NEW to our tree: 'Reduces the threat generated by your healing spells by 5%/10%/15% and reduces the chance your helpful spells and damage over time effects will be dispelled.' The threat half is built - there is no heal-specific threat key, only the global threat_generation_pct, which is a FRACTION. Dispel resistance does not exist.

nodes.name: Tidal Focus
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your healing spells by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim for the three real heals that exist: 'Reduces the mana cost of your healing spells by 1%-5%.' Chain Heal and Lesser Healing Wave do not exist here.

nodes.name: Tidal Force
nodes.description: Increases the critical chance of your Healing Wave and Riptide by 15%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the critical effect chance of your Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave and Chain Heal by 60%. Each critical heal reduces the bonus by 20%.' DEPARTURE - there is no ability to unlock and nothing decrements a buff on use, so the real talent's spend-down cannot be modelled. Delivered as a permanent but far smaller crit bonus on the two real heals. ability_<id>_crit is PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Ancestral Healing
nodes.description: Your critical heals harden you against physical damage for 4 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, NEW to our tree: 'Reduces your target's physical damage taken by 3%-10% for 15 sec after getting a critical effect from one of your healing spells.' Built with the real 10% and the real 15 seconds (4 turns). on_target is False because a talent-sourced effect cannot be aimed at the heal's recipient, so the shaman carries it - a real departure. Inside a status effect physical_damage_taken_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS, unlike the BARE damage_taken_pct in the same position, which is read raw.

nodes.name: Healing Way
nodes.description: Increases the healing of your Healing Wave by 8% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim: 'Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 8%-25%.' Stacks with Improved Healing Wave at tier 0, as the real pair does.

nodes.name: Restorative Totems
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring and Mana Tide Totems by 7% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 7%/13%/20%, and increases the amount healed by your Healing Stream Totem.' Healing Stream Totem does not exist; Mana Tide stands in as the other Water totem. BOTH now occupy the Water element slot one at a time after the totem fix, so this talent points at a real choice. It is Mana Tide Totem's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Tidal Mastery
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim: 'Increases the critical effect chance of your healing and lightning spells by 1%-5%.' crit_chance_spell covers all spells rather than those two groups; there is no way to scope crit to a spell set. PERCENTAGE POINTS.

nodes.name: Nature's Swiftness
nodes.description: Teaches Nature's Swiftness, calling the elements instantly to your aid.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, kept - the ONLY unlock for shaman_natures_swiftness, which is requires_talent. Its instant-cast clause lives in the ability, which is just as well given there are no cast times for a talent to shorten.

nodes.name: Focused Mind
nodes.description: Reduces the duration of Stun effects against you by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, NEW to our tree: 'Reduces the duration of any Silence or Interrupt effects used against the Shaman by 10%/20%/30%.' DEPARTURE - there is no silence and no interrupt key; is_stun is this engine's only incapacitate. stun_duration_reduction_pct is a FRACTION and floors a stun at 1 turn.

nodes.name: Purification
nodes.description: Increases all your healing by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3, built verbatim: 'Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 2%-10%.' healing_done is a FRACTION and is the global healing multiplier. It is Cleanse Spirit's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Nature's Guardian
nodes.description: While badly wounded, increases healing you receive by 6% per rank and reduces damage taken by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'Whenever a damaging attack brings you below 30% health, your maximum health is increased by 15% for 10 sec and your threat is reduced.' DEPARTURE on the mechanism - there is no trigger for CROSSING a health threshold, and temporary maximum health that is then removed is not expressible either. Both of the engine's actor-side low-health conditionals stand in, which fire while you are hurt rather than at the moment you become hurt. Both share low_health_threshold_pct's default of 0.5, which is why it is NOT authored.

nodes.name: Blessing of the Eternals
nodes.description: Increases your spell critical chance by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree: 'Increases the critical effect chance of your spells by 2%/4%, and increases the chance to apply the Earthliving heal effect.' Earthliving Weapon does not exist. The crit half is built verbatim.

nodes.name: Mana Tide Totem
nodes.description: Teaches Mana Tide Totem, restoring mana to your whole party.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for shaman_mana_tide_totem, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Restorative Totems, which connected_to reproduces. NOTE this ability was fixed earlier in the same session: it was target_type 'self', so a Restoration shaman's signature mana cooldown refilled only its own bar, against a real spell that restores mana 'to group members within 30 yards'. It is now party-targeted and sits in the Water element slot.

nodes.name: Nature's Blessing
nodes.description: Increases your healing power by 5% of your Intellect per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, NEW to our tree, built verbatim: 'Increases your healing by an amount equal to 5%-15% of your Intellect.' A REAL stat conversion - healing_power is a valid STAT_CONVERSION_TARGET and intellect a valid source. THE UNIT IS A RAW MULTIPLIER, not a percentage (character.py:1551: `gained = source * pct`), so 0.05 per rank reaches the real 15%.

nodes.name: Cleanse Spirit
nodes.description: Teaches Cleanse Spirit, lifting poison, disease and curse alike.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for shaman_cleanse_spirit, which is requires_talent. The real talent requires Purification, which connected_to reproduces. Moved here from the outgoing tree's capstone, where it was bundled into a node called 'Restoration Capstone' that had no counterpart in the real tree.

nodes.name: Ancestral Awakening
nodes.description: Your critical heals call an ancestral spirit to mend your neediest ally.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, NEW to our tree: 'When you critically heal with your Healing Wave, Lesser Healing Wave or Riptide you summon an Ancestral spirit to heal the lowest health party or raid member for 10%-30% of the amount healed.' Built with smart_heal, which is the engine's real 'heal whoever needs it most' payload and one of only three payloads that can read a triggering amount - so this is as close to the real talent as the engine gets. The amount is flat rather than a percentage of the heal.

nodes.name: Earth Shield
nodes.description: Teaches Earth Shield, warding an ally with the strength of stone.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, kept - the ONLY unlock for shaman_earth_shield, which is requires_talent. Its channel-protection clause has nothing to act on - there is no channelling - and its charges are not expressible, so both live in the ability. It is Improved Earth Shield's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Improved Earth Shield
nodes.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Earth Shield by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, NEW to our tree: 'Increases the amount of charges for your Earth Shield by 2, and increases the healing done by your Earth Shield by 10%/20%.' The healing half is built verbatim; charges do not exist. The real talent requires Earth Shield, reproduced. USES _healing.

nodes.name: Tidal Waves
nodes.description: Casting Riptide quickens your next heals by 20% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'When you cast Chain Heal or Riptide, you have a 20%-100% chance to lower the cast time of your Healing Wave spell by 30% and increase its critical effect chance.' DEPARTURE - no cast times, so a shorter cast becomes haste. Chain Heal does not exist, so only Riptide is in the filter. The real chance curve is kept. Ranked by chance, since a proc's payload does not scale with points.

nodes.name: Riptide
nodes.description: Teaches Riptide, a healing surge that lingers.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the capstone, kept - the ONLY unlock for shaman_riptide, which is requires_talent.

nodes.name: Call of the Ancestors
nodes.description: Teaches Call of the Ancestors, summoning the help of those who came before.
nodes._source: Kept - the ONLY unlock for shaman_call_of_ancestors, which is requires_talent. Not a WotLK talent; a Frontier addition that stays because dropping it would strand the ability, and a second tier-6 node gives the capstone row a real choice rather than a single forced point. The talent_id is kept as totemic_mastery, its name in the outgoing tree, so nothing referring to it breaks.

nodes.name: Surging Tides
nodes.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your spells by 20% per rank.
nodes._source: Authored 6 Nov. Kyle: 'all caster classes should have a 5 point talent that increases their spell crit damage by 100%.' Mirrors priest_shadow's Shadow Power and shaman_elemental's Elemental Fury, both of which are WoW-accurate at 5 x 20%. Placed on tier 4 beside the existing tier-4 block; connected_to is cosmetic (it draws the edge), spending is gated by tier_requirements.
